title: Qibble
tagline: A Prediction market on starknet with binary options and using Dynamic

prizes.placement: Pool for projects which use Dynamic
prizes.title: Pool for projects which use Dynamic

description: A prediction market concept that uses dynamic for login and onboarding. Further dynamic is used to call the STARK contract. It relies on STARK tokens for collateral and winnings. Any user can create a market and then place bets on it. Currently, the creator is the one that decides the outcome, since I was out of time on an oracle solution.
how_its_made: This project started out by exploring gnosis conditional token framework porting it to cairo and then creating a simple UI with daisy UI and further using a simple oracle mechanism to make a workable prediction market without a lot of manual intervention.  However, due to the lack of time ended up doing a simplified version that is more of a binary market.
